title: Croatian Lentil Curry
description: A hearty, comforting curry made with lentils and Croatian spices. This dish is perfect for a cold day.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lentils, bread, lazy sauce, and water. Bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
